migrations.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS patient_profile (
  patient_id           TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES patients(id),
  preferred_language   TEXT,
  medication_awareness TEXT,
  diagnosis            TEXT,
  updated_at           INTEGER NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS patient_circle_member (
  id            TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  patient_id    TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES patients(id),
  kind          TEXT NOT NULL,
  display_name  TEXT NOT NULL,
  relationship  TEXT,
  phone         TEXT,
  email         TEXT,
  is_primary_nr INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_circle_patient ON patient_circle_member(patient_id);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS patient_consent_state (
  patient_id                       TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES patients(id),
  advance_directive_status         TEXT,
  advance_directive_document_id    TEXT,
  informed_consent_status          TEXT,
  tele_consent_mode                TEXT,
  capacity_status                  TEXT,
  confidentiality_exception_active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  updated_at                       INTEGER NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS patient_safety_plan (
  patient_id               TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES patients(id),
  status                   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none',
  warning_signs            TEXT,
  coping_strategies        TEXT,
  social_settings_contacts TEXT,
  help_contacts            TEXT,
  professional_agencies    TEXT,
  means_restriction        TEXT,
  reasons_for_living       TEXT,
  shared_with_nr           INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  updated_at               INTEGER NOT NULL
);

migrations.description: Practice P3: patient_document table — protected blob-backed (O454/ADR-505 P3)
migrations.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS patient_document (
  id            TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  patient_id    TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES patients(id),
  kind          TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'document',
  title         TEXT NOT NULL,
  storage_ref   TEXT NOT NULL,
  mime_type     TEXT,
  sha256        TEXT,
  linked_kind   TEXT,
  linked_id     TEXT,
  created_at    INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_document_patient ON patient_document(patient_id, created_at DESC);

queryTemplates.sql:
SELECT id, created_at, updated_at, given_name, family_name,
       contact_phone, contact_email, dob, status
FROM patients WHERE id = @id

SELECT p.id, p.given_name, p.family_name, p.status,
       COALESCE(pl.stage, 'active') AS stage
FROM patients p
LEFT JOIN patient_lifecycle pl ON pl.patient_id = p.id
ORDER BY p.family_name ASC, p.given_name ASC

SELECT patient_id, preferred_language, medication_awareness, diagnosis, updated_at
FROM patient_profile WHERE patient_id = @id

SELECT patient_id, stage, stage_updated_at, stage_reason
FROM patient_lifecycle WHERE patient_id = @id

SELECT id, patient_id, kind, display_name, relationship, phone, email, is_primary_nr
FROM patient_circle_member WHERE patient_id = @id
ORDER BY is_primary_nr DESC, display_name ASC

SELECT id, patient_id, kind, display_name, relationship, phone, email, is_primary_nr
FROM patient_circle_member WHERE id = @id

SELECT patient_id, advance_directive_status, advance_directive_document_id,
       informed_consent_status, tele_consent_mode, capacity_status,
       confidentiality_exception_active, updated_at
FROM patient_consent_state WHERE patient_id = @id

SELECT id, patient_id, kind, severity, occurred_at, summary
FROM patient_risk_event
WHERE patient_id = @id
ORDER BY occurred_at DESC
LIMIT 50

SELECT patient_id, status, warning_signs, coping_strategies,
       social_settings_contacts, help_contacts, professional_agencies,
       means_restriction, reasons_for_living, shared_with_nr, updated_at
FROM patient_safety_plan WHERE patient_id = @id
SELECT id, patient_id, kind, title, storage_ref, mime_type, sha256, linked_kind, linked_id, created_at FROM patient_document WHERE patient_id = @id ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT
  p.id AS patient_id,
  p.given_name AS given_name,
  p.family_name AS family_name,
  COALESCE(pl.stage, 'active') AS stage,
  pl.stage_updated_at AS stage_updated_at,
  p.status AS status,
  (p.given_name IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(p.given_name)) > 0
    AND p.dob IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(p.dob)) > 0
    AND (p.contact_phone IS NOT NULL OR p.contact_email IS NOT NULL)) AS has_demographics,
  (pp.preferred_language IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(pp.preferred_language)) > 0) AS has_language,
  (pp.diagnosis IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(pp.diagnosis)) > 0) AS has_diagnosis,
  EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM patient_circle_member cm WHERE cm.patient_id = p.id) AS has_circle,
  EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM patient_circle_member cm WHERE cm.patient_id = p.id AND cm.is_primary_nr = 1) AS has_nr,
  (cs.informed_consent_status IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(cs.informed_consent_status)) > 0) AS has_informed_consent,
  (cs.tele_consent_mode IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(cs.tele_consent_mode)) > 0) AS has_tele_consent,
  (cs.capacity_status IS NOT NULL AND cs.capacity_status NOT IN ('', 'unassessed')) AS has_capacity,
  (cs.advance_directive_status IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(cs.advance_directive_status)) > 0) AS has_ad,
  (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM patient_risk_event re WHERE re.patient_id = p.id)
    OR (sp.status IS NOT NULL AND sp.status <> 'none')) AS has_risk_screen,
  EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM patient_document d WHERE d.patient_id = p.id) AS has_documents
FROM patients p
LEFT JOIN patient_profile pp ON pp.patient_id = p.id
LEFT JOIN patient_lifecycle pl ON pl.patient_id = p.id
LEFT JOIN patient_consent_state cs ON cs.patient_id = p.id
LEFT JOIN patient_safety_plan sp ON sp.patient_id = p.id
WHERE p.id = @id

SELECT

SELECT id FROM patients WHERE contact_email IS NOT NULL AND lower(trim(contact_email)) = @email
UNION
SELECT patient_id AS id FROM patient_identity_alias WHERE kind='email' AND value_norm = @email

SELECT id FROM patients WHERE contact_phone IS NOT NULL AND replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(contact_phone,' ',''),'-',''),'(',''),')',''),'+','') = @phone
UNION
SELECT patient_id AS id FROM patient_identity_alias WHERE kind='phone' AND value_norm = @phone

SELECT id FROM patients WHERE lower(trim(given_name || ' ' || COALESCE(family_name,''))) = @name OR lower(trim(COALESCE(family_name,'') || ' ' || given_name)) = @name OR lower(trim(given_name)) = @name
UNION
